title: Disposal of Land by Development Authorities Regulation Third Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Disposal of Land by Development Authorities Regulation Third Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

DISPOSAL OF LAND BY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES
DISPOSAL OF LAND BY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES
(REGULATION) (THIRD AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLVII OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Disposal of Land by Development Authorities (Regulation)
Act, 1998
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 27th August 2002]
No. Legis.13‑30/94(Part‑I),
dated 27‑8‑2002.‑‑‑The following Ordinance
promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
information:
1. Short title and
commencement. ‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Disposal of Land by Development Authorities (Regulation) (Third Amendment)
Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment in section 4 of Act XII of 1998

DISPOSAL OF LAND BY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES
DISPOSAL OF LAND BY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES
(REGULATION) (THIRD AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLVII OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Disposal of Land by Development Authorities (Regulation)
Act, 1998
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 27th August 2002]
No. Legis.13‑30/94(Part‑I),
dated 27‑8‑2002.‑‑‑The following Ordinance
promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
information:
2. Amendment in section 4 of
Act XII of 1998.‑‑‑In the said Act in section 4‑‑
(i)
in clause (a) after semi colon at the end the following proviso shall be added:‑‑
"provided that allotment of
3 to 5 Marlas residential units, multistorey flats/apartments shall be made
through ballot;" and
(ii)
in clause (b) sub‑clause (1), in column three, under the heading
"Percentage",, the
figures "95% ", 3.5% " and 1.5% at serial Nos. (i), (ii) and
(iii) shall respectively be
substituted by the figures "93 % ", "5 % " and "2
%".
